title: Grateful Dead Live at Augusta Civic Center on 1984-10-11
lineage: DAT>SHN -- Sony PCM-M1>Coax 7 pin>Zoltrix Nightingale (coax mod)> Soundforge 5.0 (No Processing)>CDWAV (track splitting)>SHN (Seekable)
source: Oade Recording -- FOB -- Schoeps CMC 441> Oade M118 > Sony TC D5>DATs (@44.1k).

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture with crystal‑clear mix, highlighted by a thumping Shakedown Street bass and a soaring Playing in the Band jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as fantastic and almost feels like the band is playing in your living room – crisp, full‑bodied sound with superb bass response.  The show itself is described as solid and spectacular, with particular love for the Shakedown Street opener and a ripping Playing in the Band jam.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are highly positive (average 4.75 stars); reviewers consistently note excellent sound quality and a strong performance, giving confidence in a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix that feels intimate; bass response on Shakedown Street highlighted as outstanding; no reported drop‑outs or noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the overall show as solid and spectacular, with a strong opening and high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass response praised on Shakedown Street opener.
